1992 PLC 344
IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH AT KARACHI
Before Naimuddin Ahmed, J
Constitutional Petition No. 890 of 1991
Messrs Alpha Industries versus Federation of Pakistan
Abid Hassan Manto, Advocate for the Petitioner
Additional Attorney-General for the Respondent
Date of institution: 03-06-1991
ORDER
NAIMUDDIN AHMED, J. The petitioner has invoked the constitutional jurisdiction of this Court against the imposition of regulatory duty. After hearing the learned counsel we are of the view that the impugned notification suffers from procedural defects. The petition is allowed and the notification is declared void. CP.A-344/L Allowed
